exposure: modified McIndoe's vaginoplasty with human amnion graft
outcome: anatomic status (length and width of neovagina)
finding: McIndoe's vaginoplasty with amnion graft resulted in a mean vaginal length of 8.2 +/- 1 cm after surgery, a mean Female Sexual Function Index score of 30.8 +/- 2.1, and complete epithelialization of the vaginal mucosa.
